name: rosetta-sum-of-a-series
code:
use default

s(n: int) -> double =>
    (1::n)
        |> map(k => 1.0 / cast double(k * k))
        |> reduce(0.0, (running, term) => running + term)

write_line("S(1000) = {s(1000)}")
fullSource:
use default

s(n: int) -> double =>
    (1::n)
        |> map(k => 1.0 / cast double(k * k))
        |> reduce(0.0, (running, term) => running + term)

write_line("S(1000) = {s(1000)}")
